title: R' Avin HaLevi bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Vayeshev 15. Hyman reports the opinion of הר״שב (Shlomo Buber) that he is R' Avin bar Chiyya, the two yods having become a mem.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Buber Tanchuma digital text of Vayeshev 15 has Avin HaLevi bar Chama. Hyman reports Buber’s proposed Chiyya reading and the two-yods-to-mem mechanism; neither printed letter shapes nor Buber’s annotation have been inspected here.

The whole Buber 1885 Tanchuma Vayeshev 15 paragraph reads abbreviated R' Avin HaLevi bar Chama. It supports the form without a full Rabbi title, rendered R'. Hyman’s identification of הר״שב as Shlomo Buber, his report of the Chiyya proposal and two-yods-to-mem explanation remain attributed. The annotation and printed glyphs were not freshly collated; no father-identity merger or Hebrew repair follows.
